messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Personal and Family Relationships" as it appears in the following examples.
['I have a desire to find out a hot lad to be pounded.', 'We were married for twenty years God give us a son, his name is Abubakar Ariana Jr who is 17 now, and because of my husband love to me, he refused to marry another wife.', 'At his hospital bed, he revealed to me the reasons of his sickness.', 'My mother died when I was a baby and since then my father took me so special.', 'I am writing this mail to you with tears and sorrow from my heart.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
